ay:
n. 贊成票, 投贊成票者
adv. 永遠
interj. (表決時說)贊成

interj. Ah! alas!
adv. Same as Aye.
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">中古法語 aymi，意為嗚呼</dd></dl>
ayah: n. (in India) a native nursemaid who looks after children
ayahuasca: n. 死藤水(用南美一種藤本植物的根泡製而成有致幻作用的飲料)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">借自美洲西班牙語和厄瓜多亞馬孫克丘亞語；美洲西班牙語 ayahuasca，借自厄瓜多亞馬孫克丘亞語 ayawaska</dd></dl>
ayatollah: n. 阿亞圖拉（對伊朗等國伊斯蘭教什葉派領袖的尊稱）
n. a high-ranking Shiite religious leader who is regarded as an authority on religious law and its interpretation and who has political power as well
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，宗教、政治用語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>波斯語、阿拉伯語 ayatullah「神的跡象」</dd></dl>
aye:
n. 贊成票, 投贊成票者
adv. 永遠
interj. (表決時說)贊成

adv. Alt. of Ay
n. An affirmative vote; one who votes in the affirmative; as, "To

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>口語，意思是「是」；表決時（正式場合）也用</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>約 1500–1600 年出現，可能來自 yea</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>aye, aye, sir；all in favor, say aye；the ayes have it</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>yes：最一般的「是」</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">表決時 aye 對 nay，the ayes 指贊成票</dd></dl>
aye-aye: n nocturnal lemur with long bony fingers and rodent-like incisor teeth closely related to the lemurs
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">法語，源自馬達加斯加語 aiay，為擬聲來源</dd></dl>
ayin: n. 希伯來文之第十六個字母
n the 16th letter of the Hebrew alphabet
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">希伯來語 ʽayin</dd></dl>
ayurveda: n (Sanskrit) an ancient medical treatise summarizing the Hindu art of healing and prolonging life; sometimes regarded as a 5th Veda
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">梵語 āyurveda，源自 āyur 生命、生命力＋veda 知識</dd></dl>
ayurvedic: n. 阿育吠陀（印度草藥按摩, 等於ayurveda）
